ImageDescription.value: Bhim Chandra Nag, one of the popular sweet shops in Kolkata, Bhim Chandra Nag was set up by Paran Chandra Nag in 1826 in Bowbazar. Nag named it after his son. It is one of the most prestigious sweet shops in the city of joy, with only two outlets on 5, Nirmal Chandra Street, and Vivekananda Road.
